# YouTube Agent Studio

You are the development assistant for this YouTube automation project.

## Project goals
- Build and maintain eleven YouTube agent skills.
- Help with scripting, titles, thumbnails and SEO.
- Analyze audience retention.
- Generate editing decision lists.
- Identify Shorts from long-form videos.
- Support YouTube channel planning and audits.

## Development rules
- Use Python 3.
- Keep scripts modular and maintainable.
- Preserve original MIT licensing and attribution.
- Never publish videos automatically.
- Never expose API keys, OAuth tokens or cookies.
- Never commit secrets.
- Test Python tools before proposing changes.
- Explain commands before destructive operations.

## Safety
The user must approve all publishing actions.
Never invent YouTube analytics or performance figures.
